change.description: Qualify the H200 AOT program using the retained L40S independent references; upstream timing baselines remain frozen

measurement_notes: Retained measurements; importing evidence does not qualify an AKAS deployment. All values are medians. Phase protocol labels describe the measured boundaries. client-stream-burst-v1 uses concurrent token-arrival timestamps: TTFT includes queueing and prefill rate is total prompt tokens divided by maximum TTFT. native-gpu-prefill-ar127-v1 uses CUDA events around native prefill and autoregressive decode. Column labels distinguish native engine delivery, CUDA events and HTTP/SSE transports. Decode counts the remaining output tokens after the first. Unqualified values retain †. Original run records and source snapshots are unchanged.

efficiency_estimates.notes: MFU is the retained mixed-arithmetic useful-FLOP estimate; MBU is expected model weight plus 16-bit KV traffic divided by H200 4.8 TB/s. These are resource-model estimates, not hardware counters or guaranteed remaining speedups. Dense FP8 peak is 1,979 TFLOP/s and 16-bit peak is 989.5 TFLOP/s. The same reference model normalizes all three runtimes; native engine and HTTP delivery overhead differ.
efficiency_estimates.target_status: Targets: prefill 160,000 tok/s, first milestone 130,000; decoding model MBU 50–70%. Current AKAS prefill peaks at about 84,400 tok/s, so both prefill milestones remain unmet. C64 reaches the requested MBU range; C1, C4, C16 and C256 remain below 50%.

tuning_evidence.scope: Full Modal worker.log for the five-concurrency AKAS run 20261102212133108734-4a2dd18e; raw kernel timing experiments and candidate declarations are retained separately. Those operator candidates are not represented as full-model throughput gains in the table.

qualification_notes: AKAS: [the H200 numerical check](../../runs/20261102214625069675-7698a25e/run.json) matched all 8 BOS and 8 chat first tokens against the retained independent references. An additional per-prompt normalized-logit regression gate failed, so H200 remains unqualified. The original L40S qualification remains passed. Built-in kernel qualification/search is now running; timing values below are retained unchanged.

vLLM: one request at C256 changed its greedy output between repetitions, causing the run-level repeatability check to fail. All requests completed 128 tokens. The frozen timing samples remain in the tables; the run-level marker also appears on the other shapes.
